function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Conduct a source-bounded investigation of the Guccifer 2.0 and DCLeaks persona narratives in relation to alleged Russian General Staff Main Intelligence Directorate (GRU)-controlled election-interference operations. Return a structured evidence dossier using only evidence actually available through the benchmark tools, with every source ID exactly as returned by the tools. Cover: (1) what the evidence establishes about the creation, operation, messaging, publication, and use of each persona; (2) all tool-supported entities and explicitly named relationships, overlaps, technical indicators, behavioral evidence, infrastructure, communications, and operational links connecting Guccifer 2.0 and DCLeaks to each other, to specific GRU officers or units, and to the wider election-interference operation; (3) the allegations, assessments, and evidentiary reasoning in relevant public indictments and incident-response reporting; (4) classify propositions as directly supported, indirectly supported, disputed, or unresolved; (5) identify apparent contradictions between persona narratives and attribution evidence, distinguishing genuine conflicts from competing interpretations or mere uncertainty; and (6) state what can responsibly be concluded as of October 1, 2026. Do not use external facts, unstated assumptions, or source IDs not returned by the benchmark tools. Clearly distinguish allegations from findings, analytic assessments from proven facts, and absence of evidence from evidence of absence. If the tools return insufficient evidence for any requested point, say so explicitly. Include a concise source inventory and quote or paraphrase the relevant returned evidence closely enough to support later citation."}
function.name: ConductResearch
